source_summary: Sparse misty river landscape with foreground trees and rocks at the lower left, a pine leaning over the water, wooded shoreline at lower center-right, distant peaks and a large hazy mountain mass at upper right, broad water/mist passages, and a small boat with two figures at lower right. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: hazy_right_mountain
motifs.description: Large distant mountain and headland rising from the mist on the upper right, with a sloping dark shoreline base and rounded pale summit forms receding off the right edge.
must_preserve: rounded summit silhouettes fading into mist
dark triangular shoreline base at lower left of the mountain

motifs.name: wooded_ridge_canopy
motifs.description: Cluster of dark treetops and scrub growing along the ridge across the upper-right hillside, separated from the larger mountain wash as a reusable foliage band.
must_preserve: fine branch strokes visible beneath dots
darker ink accents along the ridge crest
soft blending into the underlying hill wash

motifs.name: distant_mid_peaks
motifs.description: Small, misty blue-gray rock peaks near the center distance, partly veiled by the open water and haze.
must_preserve: ample surrounding mist edge without unrelated foreground trees

motifs.name: foreground_left_shrub_bank
motifs.description: Dense lower-left riverbank with tangled shrubs, small trees, and dark rock base along the left edge, excluding the large pine canopy to the right.
must_preserve: layered black-gray rock washes at the base
irregular foliage gaps and pale negative spaces

motifs.name: leaning_foreground_pine
motifs.description: Prominent foreground pine leaning from the lower left toward the center, with twisting trunk, heavy branches, and needle clusters over the water.
must_preserve: twisted dark trunk and branch contours
dense black ink accents over softer brown wash
lower roots and branch tips without including adjacent shrub mass

motifs.name: center_right_grove_shore
motifs.description: Misty grove of deciduous trees on the center-right shoreline, with trunks, stippled foliage, and a low island bank projecting into the water.
must_preserve: soft gray wash mass behind the trees
fine exposed trunks and branching silhouettes
pale water gaps and mist-softened tree edges

motifs.name: broad_mist_lake_surface
motifs.description: Open lake and mist passage across the middle and lower right, with faint horizontal water strokes and soft bands of haze around the distant shore; exclude the boat and red seal.
must_preserve: soft shoreline reflections and wash transitions
gentle tonal gradation from warm paper to gray-brown wash

motifs.name: small_fisher_boat
motifs.description: Narrow boat at the lower right carrying two small figures, one standing with a pole and one seated or crouched near the stern.
must_preserve: small seated/crouched figure at far right
delicate oar or rope-like strokes trailing along the hull

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
